svg.title: Contact sheet: Clocks, timing and holdover
svg.desc: One tile per scenario kind of the family Clocks, timing and holdover, each the chart the engine writes for a bundled example of that kind, labelled with the kind and its ledger status: clock MODELLED; sweep MODELLED; sweep-nd MODELLED (result label); telecom-timing MODELLED 5 · VALIDATED 1; slot-timing MODELLED 2 · VALIDATED 1; timetransfer MODELLED; time-transfer-budget MODELLED; holdover-test MODELLED; quantum-time-transfer MODELLED (result label). Modelled results from stated inputs, not measurements. Advisory: not type-approved navigation equipment.
